visual.detailed_description: Grayscale ultrasound image with the printed label "THYROID" at the upper left and small text "LOGIQ" and "E9" beneath it. A vertical grayscale bar sits at the left edge and a depth scale with tick numbers 0 to 3 runs down the right side, beside a column of acquisition parameter labels (CHI, Frq, Gn, S/A, Map, D, DR, AO%) with numeric values. Three pairs of small hourglass-shaped markers lie along the right depth scale. The field is dominated by grainy mid-gray textured tissue on the left and right of a central rounded dark structure that has a bright curved upper edge, faint horizontal bright lines inside it and a dark shadow below it. The textured tissue is uneven in brightness; one small round dark spot lies in the left tissue, a bright horizontal band lies at the lower left, and a rounded dark structure lies at the far right edge of the tissue. Thin bright horizontal layers run across the top, and a faint clipped fragment of two small characters lies at the extreme upper left corner of the black margin. No arrows, panel letters, measurement values or color overlay are visible.

visual.general_description: Two side-by-side color Doppler thyroid ultrasound images labelled "RT LOBE" and "LT LOBE", each with a color box of scattered red, orange, yellow and blue signal.
visual.detailed_description: Two color Doppler ultrasound images side by side on black backgrounds. Yellow label text in the upper left of each image reads "RT LOBE" on the left image and "LT LOBE" on the right image, partly overlapped by small "LOGIQ" and "E9" text. Each image has a grayscale ultrasound field with a rectangular thin yellow-outlined color box containing red, orange, yellow, blue and cyan signal, a color scale bar at the far left running from 6 at the top to -6 at the bottom with the unit "cm/s", and a depth scale 0 to 3 with parameter columns at the right (FR, CHI, CF, Frq, Gn, D, L/A, PRF, WF, S/P, AO%) with numeric values. In the left image the color box is filled with dense, widely scattered patches of mixed red, orange, yellow, blue and cyan signal, with large confluent yellow-and-blue patches at its upper left and a bright yellow-and-blue patch at its lower middle. In the right image the color box shows more sparse patches of red, orange and blue signal concentrated in its upper half, a large bright yellow-and-blue round patch near its right edge with a small blue dot below it, and a few small red specks at the lower left. A rounded dark structure with a bright curved upper edge lies at the right side of the left image and at the left side of the right image. No arrows, panel letters or measurement values other than the printed parameters are visible.
